activity_summary: At supper the boats were told, and then told again, and then the board was a board. Your father asked for the knife, heard that it was back in the shop, and did not want the arch. Anne would not tell the path. Susanna had put the book on the shelf, and she did not ask. Your mother was at the table and did not take any of it up. Richard took the end of the loaf and made no report of it. Edmund ate, and nothing was asked of him. Joan had already had the three since the middle of the afternoon. The corner of pie was gone.
